test_text: Die Geschenke null heute gepackt. (are being)
meaning: The gifts are being packed today.
grammar_tip: werden + Partizip II. The object of the active sentence becomes the subject.

test_text: Der Karton null mit Geschenkpapier beklebt. (is)
meaning: The box is covered with wrapping paper.
Is the letter being sent today?

test_text: Die Pakete werden auf der Post null. (weighed)
meaning: The parcels are weighed at the post office.

test_text: Die Marke null auf den Brief geklebt. (is)
meaning: The stamp is stuck on the letter.

test_text: Die Formulare null am Schalter ausgefüllt. (are)
meaning: The forms are filled in at the counter.

test_text: Von wem null das Paket gebracht? (is)
meaning: Who is the parcel brought by?
grammar_tip: von plus the person, werden for the action.

test_text: Die Geschenke werden von Anna null. (packed)
meaning: The gifts are packed by Anna.

tip: one step in a passive instruction

test_text: null die Pakete heute noch abgeholt? (Are)
meaning: Are the parcels still being picked up today?

test_text: Das Formular muss noch null werden. (be signed)
meaning: The form still has to be signed.
